test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no improvement required, select ‘No improvement’.

Sherpas have prospered and __come along the way__ from being just porters to becoming mountaineers.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence, the phrase 'come along the way' is incorrect and should be replaced with 'come a long way'.
 
• The correct **idiomatic **expression is 'come a long way', which means** to have made significant progress.**
 
 
• Hence, the correct sentence is: ***Sherpas have prospered and come a long way__ from being just porters to becoming mountaineers*.**
 
 
 
• ​More examples:
 __
 
• ***She has come a long way __for her days as a young reporter.***
